# SmartHome IoT Platform - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import events, streamsources, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="SmartHome IoT Platform API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build an IoT smart home dashboard with devices, sensor telemetry streams, and th...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(events.router, prefix="/api/events", tags=["Event Management"])
app.include_router(streamsources.router, prefix="/api/streamsources", tags=["StreamSource Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "SmartHome IoT Platform", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to SmartHome IoT Platform API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for SmartHome IoT Platform
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class StreamSource(Base):
    __tablename__ = "stream_sources"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    api_key_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    events_per_sec = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Event(Base):
    __tablename__ = "events"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    source_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    event_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    payload_json = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)

class MetricAggregation(Base):
    __tablename__ = "metric_aggregations"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    metric_name = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    window_interval = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    count = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    sum_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    avg_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    window_end = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

# Automated Integration Tests for SmartHome IoT Platform
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_events():
    res = client.get("/api/events/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_event():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Event", "name": "Automated Test Event", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/events/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Event" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Event"

def test_realtime_metrics():
    res = client.get("/api/events/realtime")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "events_per_sec" in res.json()

files.README.md:
# SmartHome IoT Platform

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform
- **Description**: High-velocity streaming platform with Redis stream buffer, sliding window metrics, and cold PostgreSQL storage.
- **Primary Entity**: `Event`
- **Entities**: `User`, `StreamSource`, `Event`, `MetricAggregation`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS (Permanent Cold Storage)
- **Cache**: Redis 7 Cluster (Stream Buffer & In-Memory Real-time Aggregates - Justified)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Event Producers
    APP["Web & Mobile Apps"]
    SRV["Backend Microservices"]
    IOT["Edge Sensor Gateways"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Caching (Redis Justified)
    LB["High-Throughput NLB"]
    API["SmartHome IoT Platform Ingestion Gateway"]
    REDIS_STREAM[("Redis 7 Ingestion Buffer & Aggregate Cache")]
  end

  subgraph Worker & Aggregation
    AGGREGATOR["Stream Sliding-Window Aggregator Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Permanent Archival
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 Columnar/Timeseries Archival")]
    DASH["Live Stream Analytics Dashboard"]
  end

  APP --> LB --> API
  SRV --> LB --> API
  IOT --> LB --> API
  API --> REDIS_STREAM
  REDIS_STREAM --> AGGREGATOR
  AGGREGATOR --> REDIS_STREAM
  AGGREGATOR --> PG
  DASH --> REDIS_STREAM
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smarthome-iot-platform`

# ShopVault E-Commerce Platform - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import products, orders, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="ShopVault E-Commerce Platform API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Create an e-commerce website for small businesses with user authentication, prod...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(products.router, prefix="/api/products", tags=["Product Management"])
app.include_router(orders.router, prefix="/api/orders", tags=["Order Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "ShopVault E-Commerce Platform", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to ShopVault E-Commerce Platform API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for ShopVault E-Commerce Platform
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = "products"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False, index=True)
    sku = Column(String(100), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    stock_quantity = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    category = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orders"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    total_amount = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    shipping_address = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class OrderItem(Base):
    __tablename__ = "order_items"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    product_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    quantity = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    unit_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

# Automated Integration Tests for ShopVault E-Commerce Platform
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_products():
    res = client.get("/api/products/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_product():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Product", "name": "Automated Test Product", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/products/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Product" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Product"

def test_order_checkout():
    res = client.post("/api/products/1/checkout")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "paid"

files.README.md:
# ShopVault E-Commerce Platform

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: E-Commerce & Order Management Platform
- **Description**: Scalable digital commerce engine with product catalog, cart, and payment checkout sandbox.
- **Primary Entity**: `Product`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Product`, `Order`, `OrderItem`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS Multi-AZ
- **Cache**: None (catalog indexed directly in Postgres)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Customer Clients
    SHOPPER["Web Storefront (React 18)"]
    MOBILE["Mobile Responsive Web"]
  end

  subgraph Edge & API Gateway
    CDN["CloudFront / Edge CDN"]
    LB["Application Load Balancer"]
  end

  subgraph Core Microservices
    API["ShopVault E-Commerce Platform FastAPI Gateway"]
    CATALOG["Catalog & Inventory Service"]
    ORDER_SVC["Order Processing Service"]
    CHECKOUT_SVC["Checkout & Payment Gateway Sandbox"]
  end

  subgraph Data Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Products, Orders, OrderItems)")]
    S3[("S3 Bucket (Product Media Assets)")]
  end

  SHOPPER --> CDN --> LB --> API
  MOBILE --> LB --> API
  API --> CATALOG
  API --> ORDER_SVC
  API --> CHECKOUT_SVC
  CATALOG --> PG
  ORDER_SVC --> PG
  CHECKOUT_SVC --> PG
  CATALOG --> S3
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/shopvault-e-commerce-platform`
